operators.name: channel_sum
semantics: x = torch.sum(x, dim=1): reduce over dimension 1 (channel dimension) keeping batch, height, width dims.
Keeps all other dimensions and removes the reduced dimension, matching torch.sum keepdim=False.
The reduction is along the contiguous innermost stride-1 tensor slices when input is contiguous, but the kernel must use the actual strides to support non-contiguous inputs as well.

operators.name: exp
semantics: Output tensor has identical shape, dtype, device, and stride as input.
Reduction along dim=1. Input shape [512,3,512,512], output shape [512,512,512].
Sum all three channel elements for each (batch, height, width) position.
Element-wise exponential using the result of step_001.
Forward returns the exp output tensor of shape [512,512,512].
The final return is the same tensor as step_002.
